title: Review a technical blog post for factual accuracy. Report discrepancies only. Do not edit any files.
summary: I found 15 discrepancies in the post and 4 places where its claims about papers go further than the research notes support. Most of the numbers do recompute from `compares.json`. The biggest problems are how many tasks #37 really ran, how two judged turns are described, and one fix that the post dates to before #36 but that landed after #37. I did not edit any files.
